summary: Implemented JSON pretty printing in the rich repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py (base "json.", one combined pattern); new rich/json.py with the JSON renderable (parse, re-serialize with indent, highlight or null highlighter, no_wrap=True, overflow=None, stored in .text, returned from __rich__) and a __main__ CLI using soft_wrap; six json.* entries in rich/default_styles.py; Console.print_json after print in rich/console.py; package-level print_json before inspect in rich/__init__.py (__all__ unchanged); docs in docs/source/console.rst ("Printing JSON" section, single "Low level output" heading), new docs/source/reference/json.rst, toctree entry in reference.rst; CHANGELOG Unreleased Added entry; new tests in tests/test_print_json.py (existing tests untouched). Judgment calls: overflow set to Python None per the spec's "none"; the expected ANSI codes in the Console test were derived by reading Style._make_ansi_codes, not by running them, so that test is unverified. Nothing committed.
